features.statement: Layout is a centered, contained multi-column grid with flex rows rather than a single flush-left column.
Pairs a system sans-serif for UI and headlines with a serif face for excerpts, taglines and placeholders.
Section headings are small uppercase with letter-spacing, in bold sans.
Page uses a warm off-white background with near-black navy body text.
Top bar, nav band and footer use a dark navy fill with white text.
Category labels are small uppercase white-on-red badge chips.
Posts appear as bordered white cards in a 3-column grid with image, badge, title, meta and excerpt.
Page opens with a hero: large featured image with overlaid white headline on dark gradient, plus stacked side cards.
Each post is wrapped in an article element.
Header shows a compact small logo beside a large serif site name, with an italic tagline quote.
A labeled trending badge precedes a horizontal row of headline links.
Primary navigation is a horizontal row of category links in a dark top bar.
Posts without images get text-labeled gradient placeholder tiles showing the category name.
Thumbnails are cropped to uniform sizes, with small thumbnails in sidebar lists.
Author widget shows a small circular avatar with name and subtitle.
Popular list is numbered with red numerals beside small thumbnails.
Tags render as uniform-size bordered pill chips.
Search is a joined input-plus-button bar with short placeholder, appearing once.
Section headings have a heavy underline rule and a red 'View all →' link at right.
Meta lines separate author and date with a centered dot.
Card titles are bold sans-serif without underline.
Markup is lean: few classes, minimal head metadata, a single stylesheet and no JSON-LD.
Every image carries an alt attribute, mostly empty for decorative images.
Excerpts appear on hero and lead-row cards only; later cards show just title and meta.
Footer is a three-column block with a divider line above the copyright.
